title: feat(lint): dashboard and report advisories carry a localized user sentence
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoWK5rFW1SUGSkDw9iatZE4f)_

Fixes #32837

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘和报表的保存提示（advisory）现在也有给最终用户看的一句话，11 种平台语言都有：组件绑定规则 7 条、报表图表规则 2 条，共 9 条规则 id；规则 id、`message`、`hint` 一字不变。
- 为什么改：按 #32835 / #32655 已落地的做法（裁决 6819749037 选 C），中文 Studio 里保存仪表盘看到的仍是英文提醒；现在由出提醒的规则自己按用户语言出文案。卡片表里 11 条中有 2 条保存时根本不会返回（数据集层面的聚合提醒、页面可视化提醒），它们没有用户文案，原因写在验收说明里。
- 风险与回滚：只新增文案和发现对象上的一个可选字段；保存接口现在还不填 `userMessage`（那是 #32656），所以所有返回内容不变。`@objectstack/lint` 按 patch 发版。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-widget-bindings.user-text.ts`（7 条的各语言文案）、`packages/lint/src/validate-chart-bindings.ts`（只在报表图表系列条目上带参数的那两处）、`packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts`，应见 24 个测试全绿，其中两条是从发布门（仪表盘写入、报表写入）拿到的提示渲染成能被 `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` 解析的 `userMessage`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Layer 1 of #32654 for the dashboard and report advisories, in the pattern #32655 landed (`validate-security-posture.user-text.ts`, `finding-user-text.test.ts`), under ruling record 6819749037 (option C).

**Re-measured first.** The card's table (11 ids, a static-scan upper bound) was checked by running every warning push site of the three files whole-stack and through `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` on `main` `2c98485d`. Nine ids reach the publish door; two do not:

| Rule file | Door-reaching advisory ids | Not reaching the door |
|---|---|---|
| `validate-widget-bindings.ts` (dashboard write) | `widget-legacy-analytics-shape`, `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned`, `chart-field-unknown` (x-axis site, and the y-axis/series site), `chart-measures-missing`, `widget-measures-missing`, `chart-dimensions-missing`, `table-count-only` | `measure-aggregate-incoherent` |
| `validate-chart-bindings.ts` (report write, a report chart's `series[]` entry) | `chart-measure-unknown`, `chart-axis-not-selected` | — |
| `validate-page-visualization-bindings.ts` | — | `page/visualization-without-binding` |

The seat agreed to cover the nine only (thread record, 14:18Z). See Acceptance notes for why the two stay on the English `message`.

**`packages/lint`.**

- `validate-widget-bindings.user-text.ts` (new, beside the rule): the 7 widget ids' sentences in all 11 `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, in the dashboard editor's terms from `ui/packages/i18n` (dashboard, widget, dataset, dimensions, values, measure, metric). `chart-field-unknown` has one arm per position (`axis`: `x`, `y`, `series`) and `widget-measures-missing` one per what the widget fails to show (`shows`: `number` for the metric family, `table` for the tabular one), as the rule's message does.
- `validate-chart-bindings.user-text.ts` (new): the 2 chart ids' sentences, addressed to the report's chart series entry, the one advisory position the door reaches. `chart-axis-not-selected` names the measure the chart plots.
- Push sites: `validate-widget-bindings.ts` sets `userTextParams` at the 8 push sites of the 7 ids (both `chart-field-unknown` sites); `validate-chart-bindings.ts` sets it on the two ids' `report-series` findings only, carrying the report name on the report chart binding (`ChartBinding.report`). Both finding interfaces gain `userTextParams?`. A query-position `chart-measure-unknown` (an error) and the page-chart presentation positions (judged on pages, which no per-write snapshot carries) carry none. Rule ids, `message` and `hint` are unchanged.
- `finding-user-text.ts`: `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` merges the two catalogs beside the security one via `mergeUserTextCatalogs`.
- No new export: the catalogs stay internal, as `SECURITY_POSTURE_USER_TEXT` is.

**Changeset.** `.changeset/32837-advisory-user-text.md`, `@objectstack/lint` `patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. Precedent followed: #32790 (the #32655 PR) declared `Metadata-protocol: added` only because `@objectstack/spec` gained the authorable `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema.userMessage` key, and it shipped its `packages/lint` half (catalog, params, merge) as `patch`. This PR is that lint half alone: no spec key, no accepted value, nothing a metadata author writes changes, so `none` and `patch`.

**Not in this PR.** The save door composing `userMessage` (#32656) and the console rendering it (#32657). Until #32656 lands, every save and publish response is byte-identical.

## Tests

Counts from the tree at `6f88ae2d` (main `2c98485d`). The head `715ce9e3` merges `main` `e997113c` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (3 incoming commits: a hook description in `packages/spec`, a skills reference, PM docs; none touches `packages/lint`; no conflict; no generated artifact left to regenerate). After the merge: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated` (all 14 artifacts up to date), and the two user-text pin files, 52 passed (52), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `packages/lint/src/finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts` (new, 24 tests):
  - exact coverage: the widget catalog holds exactly the 7 ids and the chart catalog exactly the 2, each in exactly the 11 platform locales; both are the entries `FINDING_USER_TEXT_CATALOG` serves; the 9 ids are pinned by value;
  - the two ids the door never returns have no catalog entry;
  - every push site rendered from the rule's real findings (12 cases: 8 widget push sites with both `widget-measures-missing` arms and all three `chart-field-unknown` positions, and both chart ids): severity `warning`, the exact params, every locale truthy, no `undefined` or template residue, every interpolated name present, and no English stand-in in any non-English locale;
  - the three `chart-field-unknown` arms render apart in every locale, and the two `widget-measures-missing` arms differ in every locale;
  - zh-Hans and en spot checks; `chart-axis-not-selected` names the plotted measure;
  - no params where the finding is not door advice: a query-position `chart-measure-unknown` error, a page chart's two presentation warnings, and `measure-aggregate-incoherent`;
  - from the runtime gate to the wire field: a `dashboard` write's `chart-dimensions-missing` and a `report` write's `chart-axis-not-selected` come out of `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` with their params, and the rendered `userMessage` (zh-CN request; fr-FR request in a zh-CN workspace) parses under `RuntimeAuthoringIssueSchema` beside the unchanged rule id and message.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: Test Files 203 passed (203), Tests 8639 passed (8639), `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Consumer reading (`@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, which runs the gate on every save): Test Files 337 passed, 7 skipped (344); Tests 22799 passed, 36 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

<details><summary>Ablations (committed first at 6f88ae2d, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restored to the HEAD blob)</summary>

| # | Mutation | Observed |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `validate-widget-bindings.ts`: drop `userTextParams` at the `table-count-only` push site | 1 failed, 23 passed (that site's render case) |
| 2 | `validate-chart-bindings.ts`: drop `report: reportName` from the report chart binding | 4 failed, 20 passed (both chart render cases, the plotted-measure case, the report-write gate case) |

Each mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed) and each restore read `blob == HEAD and git diff HEAD is empty`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Two card ids stay on the English fallback, by measurement.** `measure-aggregate-incoherent` is judged on `datasets[]`; a dashboard write carries the live datasets as context in both differential passes, so the finding cancels, and a dataset write does not run `validateWidgetBindings` (its registry entry declares `runtimeTypes: ['dashboard']`). `page/visualization-without-binding` is a reference-integrity member on the frozen `flow` default, and no per-write snapshot carries `pages[]`; a page write does not dispatch it. A sentence the door can never render would be declared but not delivered. Parent #32835 allows naming such ids with the reason they stay on the English fallback.
- **Agent-written non-English sentences, for the native-review round.** All non-English sentences in both new catalogs are agent-written: 10 locales (`zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `es`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `de`, `ja`, `ko`) × 9 entries, 13 sentences per locale counting arms (`widget-legacy-analytics-shape`, `dashboard-filter-field-unprovisioned`, `chart-field-unknown` ×3, `chart-measures-missing`, `widget-measures-missing` ×2, `chart-dimensions-missing`, `table-count-only`, `chart-measure-unknown`, `chart-axis-not-selected`). Points worth a native reader's eye: `de` uses the console's "Datensatz" for dataset, so `table-count-only` says "Einträge" for records to avoid the clash; `ar` uses the console's "مقياس" both for the metric widget type and for a measure, so the metric widget is spelled "عنصر من نوع مقياس"; Korean particles are written in the dual form (`을(를)`, `이(가)`) because the name is interpolated.
- **API names, not labels**, as the security catalog does (its N3, accepted): the rule is a pure function of the stack with no label lookup in the request's language. A dashboard or widget with no name shows the rule's stand-in.
- **New test file, not `finding-user-text.test.ts`.** The pins sit in `finding-user-text.dashboards.test.ts` so this card and its parallel sibling #32836 do not both grow the precedent's file; the shape is the same. Moving them into that file is a mechanical follow-up if the seat prefers it.
- Card #33072 edits `validate-expressions.ts`; this PR does not touch it. #32836 also adds one line to `finding-user-text.ts`; whichever lands second merges `main` and keeps both catalogs.

## Verification

Local subset at `6f88ae2d` (the merge brought in no file this derivation reads, and the change set against `main` is the same 7 paths), derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (60 families), every line run with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe, then reconciled with `--ran`: **60 derived, 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 60 recorded an exit code, none is 3)**. All 60 exit 0. The record is `spec-seat-2/r2026-11-13/out/32837-gates-ran-6f88ae2d.list` in the project files.

<details><summary>Four families needed a prerequisite before their reading</summary>

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 on the shallow clone (pinned fixture commit `621a4876` absent); exit 0 after fetching that commit.
- `pnpm check:dts-closure`: exit 1 (a consumer closure built without declarations); exit 0 after a full workspace build with declarations.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (no dist); exit 0 after the same full build.

</details>

`node scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs` (run after editing the catalogs, since a pt-BR or es sentence opening with "os " trips it): exit 0, 1322 command-id literals resolve.

CI runs the rest of the farm on this PR; its check-runs are the reading for every family outside the local subset.
